messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar-related workflow, the passages do **not** support using a Signaling Tester as the radar test system; Signaling Tester fits only if the DUT also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communication links that need UE signaling, RF, protocol, application, or de-sense validation, while radar/EME/EMC testing remains a separate workflow [28][38].  
### Workflow fit
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / electromagnetic environment testing | Knowledge base places military / aviation drone testing under EMC, EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout, and system-level effects testing, not under cellular/WLAN signaling test [28]. | [28] |
| Radar station as RF threat / susceptibility source | DO-160 RF susceptibility testing covers exposure to RF modulated power and notes emissions can come from external radiators such as radar stations [16]. | [16] |
| Communication-link validation on the same platform | CMX500 signaling test fits if the Aerospace / Defense DUT includes LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi UE behavior, because the cited signaling solution covers LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE signaling test, RF measurements, application-layer tests, and protocol test [38]. | [38] |
| De-sense / coexistence around comms radios | UAV signaling test solution focuses CMX500 on UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test and de-sense validation, but the passage explicitly says not to treat CMX500 signaling as an EMC / EME test system [28]. | [28] |
| Non-signaling waveform generation / replay | CMX500 GPRF Generator is a non-signaling use case that can generate ARB, CW, dual-tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [43]. | [43] |
| Captured-IQ replay support | The CMX500 GPRF workflow can replay waveforms from IQ capture, MATLAB, or other sources, and the IQ recorder can save `.wv` files for replay [44][45]. | [44][45] |
| Dedicated radar echo / target simulation | For radar-under-test echo generation, the cited radar instrument is AREG800A, which provides dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation up to 3000 m, but the cited passages identify it as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator rather than an Aerospace / Defense radar system [19][21]. | [19][21] |
### Practical placement
| Test phase | Fit |
|---|---|
| Before / beside radar EMC-EME testing | Use Signaling Tester only to establish and measure the DUT’s LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communication behavior, because the cited CMX500 scope is signaling, RF measurement, application-layer, and protocol test for LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE [38]. |
| During radar/EME susceptibility scenario | Do not treat the Signaling Tester as the radar/EME generator, because the cited UAV solution separates signaling test from EMC / EMI / EMS / EME and warns not to infer CMX500 signaling as an EMC / EME test system [28]. |
| For non-signaling RF stimulus or replay | Use Non-signaling / GPRF functions as an auxiliary RF waveform replay or standalone TX measurement tool, because the cited CMX500 GPRF use case supports ARB, CW, dual tone, `.wv` replay, R&D waveform replay / creation, and standalone TX measurement [43]. |
| For actual radar echo simulation | Use a radar echo generator role rather than a signaling tester role, because AREG800A is the cited product for dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation [21]. |
### 【推論】
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, place the Signaling Tester on the communications-validation branch and the Non-signaling Tester on auxiliary RF waveform replay / TX-measurement tasks, while radar susceptibility, EME, and radar echo simulation remain separate test branches supported by EMC/EME context and radar echo generation sources [16][21][28][38][43].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › Complex EME emulation
來源的 RF electromagnetic environment 章節列出：

- emulate complex EME signals。
- enable the military electromagnetic spectrum operation。
- emulating different electromagnetic environment。
- evaluating military system level effects under EM interferences。
- simulating different operational scenarios。

這支持 [[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 的客製化測試方向，但來源未提供 signal library、scenario definition、threat emitter model、功率、頻段、同步或安全條件。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › MIL-STD-464 system-level testing
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 說 [[MIL-STD-464]] provides the basis of environment testing for vehicles that have to work in the most unforgiving condition，並將其描述為 system level testing standard。

來源列出的 main chapter / sub-items 包含：

- margins，6 dB margins。
- intra-system EMC。
- hull generated intermodulation interference / IMI。
- shipboard internal EME。
- multipaction。
- induced levels at antenna ports of antenna-connected receivers。
- external RF EME。
- [[High Power Microwave]] / HPM sources。
- lightning。
- [[Electromagnetic Pulse]] / EMP。
- subsystems and equipment electromagnetic interference / EMI。
- portable electronics devices and carry-on equipment requirements。
- non-developmental items / NDI and commercial items。
- electrostatic environments。
- radiation hazards / RADHAZ：HERP、HERF、HERO。
- life cycle / E3 hardness。
- electrical bonding、power current return path、antenna installations、mechanical interfaces、shock / fault / ignitable vapour protection。
- external grounds。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 defense tool
來源整理多個 defense-oriented use cases：

- jamming detection and classification。
- GPS spoofing detection。
- UAV IDS。
- signal source identification。
- RF emitter localization。
- passive RF monitoring。
- counter-UAV detection and mitigation。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar-related workflow, the passages do **not** support using a Signaling Tester as the radar test system; Signaling Tester fits only if the DUT also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communication links that need UE signaling, RF, protocol, application, or de-sense validation, while radar/EME/EMC testing remains a separate workflow [28][38].  
### Workflow fit
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / electromagnetic environment testing | Knowledge base places military / aviation drone testing under EMC, EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout, and system-level effects testing, not under cellular/WLAN signaling test [28]. | [28] |
| Radar station as RF threat / susceptibility source | DO-160 RF susceptibility testing covers exposure to RF modulated power and notes emissions can come from external radiators such as radar stations [16]. | [16] |
| Communication-link validation on the same platform | CMX500 signaling test fits if the Aerospace / Defense DUT includes LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi UE behavior, because the cited signaling solution covers LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE signaling test, RF measurements, application-layer tests, and protocol test [38]. | [38] |
| De-sense / coexistence around comms radios | UAV signaling test solution focuses CMX500 on UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test and de-sense validation, but the passage explicitly says not to treat CMX500 signaling as an EMC / EME test system [28]. | [28] |
| Non-signaling waveform generation / replay | CMX500 GPRF Generator is a non-signaling use case that can generate ARB, CW, dual-tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [43]. | [43] |
| Captured-IQ replay support | The CMX500 GPRF workflow can replay waveforms from IQ capture, MATLAB, or other sources, and the IQ recorder can save `.wv` files for replay [44][45]. | [44][45] |
| Dedicated radar echo / target simulation | For radar-under-test echo generation, the cited radar instrument is AREG800A, which provides dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation up to 3000 m, but the cited passages identify it as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator rather than an Aerospace / Defense radar system [19][21]. | [19][21] |
### Practical placement
| Test phase | Fit |
|---|---|
| Before / beside radar EMC-EME testing | Use Signaling Tester only to establish and measure the DUT’s LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communication behavior, because the cited CMX500 scope is signaling, RF measurement, application-layer, and protocol test for LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE [38]. |
| During radar/EME susceptibility scenario | Do not treat the Signaling Tester as the radar/EME generator, because the cited UAV solution separates signaling test from EMC / EMI / EMS / EME and warns not to infer CMX500 signaling as an EMC / EME test system [28]. |
| For non-signaling RF stimulus or replay | Use Non-signaling / GPRF functions as an auxiliary RF waveform replay or standalone TX measurement tool, because the cited CMX500 GPRF use case supports ARB, CW, dual tone, `.wv` replay, R&D waveform replay / creation, and standalone TX measurement [43]. |
| For actual radar echo simulation | Use a radar echo generator role rather than a signaling tester role, because AREG800A is the cited product for dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar echo generation [21]. |
### 【推論】
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, place the Signaling Tester on the communications-validation branch and the Non-signaling Tester on auxiliary RF waveform replay / TX-measurement tasks, while radar susceptibility, EME, and radar echo simulation remain separate test branches supported by EMC/EME context and radar echo generation sources [16][21][28][38][43].

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

R&S AREG800A › 文件與適用條件
- 來源文件：[[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]。
- 文件編號：`PD 3609.8015.22`。
- 文件版本：`Version 09.00`。
- 文件日期：`September 2025（LA）`。
- 文件名稱：`AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`。
- Copyright：`© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。
- 資料註記：無 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力；資料 `subject to change`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 於環境溫度儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- `Specifications with limits`：以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示保證產品性能。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：表示保證產品性能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依 GUM 計算。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions › 與 signaling test 的區分
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 依 [[Signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 UAV [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation。
- [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 聚焦 [[EMC]]、[[EMI]]、[[EMS]]、[[EME]]、radiated / conducted layout 與 system-level effects test。

兩者可同屬 drone test solution 線索，但不可把 CMX500 signaling option 自動推論為 EMC / EME test system，也不可把 EMC 系統推論為 cellular / WLAN protocol tester。

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Waveform replay
來源描述可 replay any waveform from：

- IQ capture。
- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

流程線索包含：

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。
